name: Essex LNP Community Fund

funder.name: Essex Local Nature Partnership, Essex Wildlife Trust and Essex County Council

summary: Small grants for community groups, charities, schools and local organisations in Essex for nature projects such as habitat creation or restoration, habitat connectivity and protecting existing habitats, aligned with the Local Nature Recovery Strategy.
reporting: Successful applicants give feedback on project outcomes and write an end-of-project report.

applicant_types.quote: Community groups, charities, schools and other local organisations can apply for grants of £500 to £2,000

geography.quote: designed to empower local communities to take action in Essex for nature

amount.quote: Community groups, charities, schools and other local organisations can apply for grants of £500 to £2,000

reporting.quote: Successful applicants will be asked to provide feedback on project outcomes, producing a report at the end of their project
